faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.question1: How do I create an account?
faq.answer1: Click on Get Started and fill in your details. Verify your email to activate your account.
faq.question2: Is OnlineJob Portal free to use?
faq.answer2: Yes! Creating an account and applying for jobs is completely free for job seekers.
faq.question3: How do I apply for a job?
faq.answer3: Browse jobs, click on a job listing, and click Apply Now. Make sure your profile and CV are up to date.
faq.question4: Can employers post jobs for free?
faq.answer4: Yes, employers can post jobs after creating a company profile and getting admin approval.
faq.question5: How long does it take to get a response?
faq.answer5: Response times vary by employer. You can track your application status in your dashboard.
